description: This file defines a template class 'QuicheLinkedHashMap', a simplistic insertion-ordered map that combines a list and a hash map for maintaining insertion order and efficient lookups. It provides methods for insertion, deletion, iteration, and access, with no thread safety guarantees.

classes.name: quiche::QuicheLinkedHashMap
classes.description: A template class implementing an insertion-ordered map using a combination of a list and a hash map for efficient insertion, deletion, and iteration while maintaining insertion order.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to the first element in insertion order.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator past the last element.

methods.name: rbegin
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator to the last element.

methods.name: rend
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator before the first element.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all elements from the map.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the map is empty.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes element(s) by key or iterator.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds element by key, returns iterator.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses or inserts element by key.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Constructs and inserts element in place.
